ec6606822833912094053991858dc8d3444ed9cf.summary: IBM X-Force IRIS links recent intrusions to Hive0065, also known as TA505, a financially motivated cybercrime group active since at least 2014. The group uses spear phishing with malicious Office documents and spoofed cloud services to deliver SDBbot, a remote-access Trojan used mainly as a second-stage payload. Victims were also seen with a Meterpreter reverse shell, a TinyMet stager and a DLL with CobaltStrike similarities. The report describes SDBbot's installer, loader and RAT components and lists indicators of compromise.
